name: @sesame/api
description: Sesame's vault-blind website account and metadata API

scripts.lint: npm run vet && node ./scripts/run-go.mjs run github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/v2/cmd/golangci-lint@v2.12.2 run ./...
scripts.ci: npm run release:contract && npm run openapi:check && npm run vet && npm run build && npm run test
scripts.test:fuzz: node ./scripts/run-go.mjs test -run '^$' -fuzz FuzzDecode -fuzztime 30s ./internal/syncproto && node ./scripts/run-go.mjs test -run '^$' -fuzz FuzzVerifyActivation -fuzztime 15s ./internal/syncproto && node ./scripts/run-go.mjs test -run '^$' -fuzz FuzzVerifyRevocationIntent -fuzztime 15s ./internal/syncproto && node ./scripts/run-go.mjs test -run '^$' -fuzz FuzzVerifyReceipt -fuzztime 15s ./internal/syncproto
